successCriteria.description: The LeaveBalance entity is defined with the exact canonical fields id, employeeId, policyId, totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays, fiscalYear, status, createdAt, updatedAt (id/createdAt/updatedAt repository-generated, never caller-supplied).

ILeaveBalanceRepository exposes findByEmployee, findByEmployeeAndPolicy, findByEmployeeAndFiscalYear, create, update, and commitDays; write methods accept an optional PoolClient as the last parameter and default to the shared pool.
commitDays atomically increments usedDays and decrements remainingDays by the same integer amount, and rejects (does not clamp) any commit that would drive remainingDays below zero.
usedDays and remainingDays are persisted and returned as integers with no rounding; remainingDays always equals totalEntitlement - usedDays and is non-negative.

A unique-constraint violation (pg code 23505) on (employee_id, policy_id, fiscal_year) is mapped to UniqueConstraintError; a missing row on update/commitDays throws BalanceNotFoundError (code BALANCE_NOT_FOUND).
Jest unit tests exist under tests/unit/modules/balance/ covering the repository (mocking src/shared/db), the service (injecting a fake repository), and the error types, and the suite passes.

constraints: Repository queries use raw pg parameterized SQL against the shared pool; Knex is for migrations only and must not appear in repository queries.
No `any` (use `unknown` with type guards); no direct DB access outside the repository layer; no hardcoded secrets; no @gestalt/* dependencies.
The balance module is a thin facade and does NOT orchestrate audit records; audit on state changes is the leave service's responsibility (GP-002).

The service owns the unit of work; the data-access layer opens it. Services take an injected IUnitOfWork with withTransaction(fn) and never import a pool/client/module-level db helper; withTransaction must not live on a repository.

balance may import only from shared-types and shared-db, plus RepositoryError and UniqueConstraintError from the employee module's public entry point (src/modules/employee/index.ts); no other module dependencies.
status is a plain string with lifecycle values ACTIVE and CLOSED (not an enum); id/createdAt/updatedAt are repository-generated via randomUUID() and never caller-supplied.
outOfScope: Audit orchestration for balance state changes (GP-002) — owned by the leave service, not the balance module.
HTTP routes/controllers, API-boundary validation, and RBAC guards for balance — no controller/routes files in this phase.
Background jobs / accrual schedulers (BullMQ) and notification fanout — none in this feature.
Database migrations/DDL for leave_balances — this phase implements the repository against the already-reconciled schema.

entityInvariants.invariant: remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays, always non-negative; usedDays and remainingDays are integers with no rounding.
status is a plain string restricted to ACTIVE or CLOSED; a balance is uniquely identified by (employeeId, policyId, fiscalYear).

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Rejects (throws) when the commit would drive remainingDays below zero; throws BalanceNotFoundError when no matching balance row exists; joins a caller's transaction via optional PoolClient.
Maps pg unique-violation 23505 on (employee_id, policy_id, fiscal_year) to UniqueConstraintError; generates id/createdAt/updatedAt itself.
Throws BalanceNotFoundError when no row matches; maps 23505 to UniqueConstraintError; only supplied fields are persisted.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Reuse the shared pg Pool exported from connection.ts (never create a second pool); write methods fall back to it when no client is supplied.
Import RepositoryError and UniqueConstraintError from the employee module's public entry point rather than redeclaring them; add only BalanceNotFoundError locally.

Mirror the policy repository's raw-pg patterns: randomUUID() id, const conn = client ?? pool, snake_case→camelCase mapRow, RETURNING column list, dynamic SET clause for update, and 23505→UniqueConstraintError mapping.
Match the canonical LeaveBalance entity/table shape (leave_balances, snake_case columns, PK id, FKs to employees.id and leave_policies.id, unique (employee_id, policy_id, fiscal_year)).
Follow the module file convention (model, repository, service, service.interface, errors, index) and the thin delegating service facade with injectable repository defaulting to the concrete class.

integrationPoints.why: Repository reads/writes run against the single shared pool; write methods accept an optional PoolClient to join the leave service's transaction.
Balance module may import shared enums/types; the dependency map limits balance to shared-types and shared-db.
Balance reuses the shared error base classes rather than redeclaring them, matching the policy module's pattern.
commitDays is the transactional primitive the leave service will call during approve/reject to debit a balance atomically.
